long_biography.plain_text:
Melina Travlos began learning shipping at 15, accompanying her father, Nikos Travlos, around the Piraeus business he had founded decades earlier. After studying business administration at Northeastern University in Boston, she joined the family enterprise and ultimately succeeded him, developing Neptune Lines' vehicle-carrier and logistics platform while preserving its operating roots.

In 2017, Travlos launched Neptune Dry Management, adding dry-bulk operations as a personally founded branch alongside the inherited Neptune platform. She later moved from day-to-day executive management to chairing Neptune Group. Separately, she became the first woman to lead the Union of Greek Shipowners and won a second term in 2025; she also serves on the Acropolis Museum board.
